docs: Event intro content: an optional badge, the name of the event as the heading, a description, the date, the place and one action. One object is valid in every event intro layout (centred, at the start).

badge.docs: a short pill above the heading; empty: no badge

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

date.docs: the date and the time as they are shown

place.docs: the place or the city, or online

actionLabel.docs: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set
